content.title: Observed Ordinary Day | Controlled Imperfection and Camera Discovery
content.summary: Follow one original clearly adult subject through at least four ordinary route chapters with stable clothing, carried-object or gait anchors. Maintain deliberate but bounded observer imperfections—slightly late pans, short foreground occlusions, modest focus recovery and breathing-scale sway—while always returning to the subject and route. The subject must avoid direct camera acknowledgment until the final chapter. End with one unmistakable eye-line change and short approach that reveals awareness of the recorder.

quick_start.input_format: Lock one clearly adult original subject with at least three clothing, object or gait anchors across four ordinary chapters. + Use only bounded observer imperfections and always recover the subject and route. + Carry one object, direction or completed action from each chapter into the next. + Do not let the subject directly acknowledge the camera before the final chapter. + End with one clear eye-line change and short approach toward the lens.
quick_start.recommended_input: Open on one original clearly adult marine biologist in a navy deck coat, brass key clip and white boot stripe leaving a research bunk with a blue sample bag; the handheld camera begins half a beat late and catches up. At a tide pool, the adult tags one sample, rests beside a gull and drinks water. Use modest focus recovery and breathing sway, but the adult never looks directly at camera. Only now the adult hears the recorder, turns eyes directly to lens and takes two short steps closer with a questioning expression. Hold before touch; no source man, market, orange, cat, rooftop or exact framing.

creative_dna.mechanism: Follow one original clearly adult subject through at least four ordinary route chapters with stable clothing, carried-object or gait anchors. Maintain deliberate but bounded observer imperfections—slightly late pans, short foreground occlusions, modest focus recovery and breathing-scale sway—while always returning to the subject and route. The subject must avoid direct camera acknowledgment until the final chapter. End with one unmistakable eye-line change and short approach that reveals awareness of the recorder. The reusable mechanism is ordinary route continuity, controlled observer imperfection, delayed acknowledgment and camera-discovery closure—not the source man, apartment, market, fruit, cat, rooftop, exact framing, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Lock one clearly adult original subject with at least three clothing, object or gait anchors across four ordinary chapters.
invariants.ablation_failure: Unanchored chapter changes suggest different people or days.

invariants.rule: Use only bounded observer imperfections and always recover the subject and route.
invariants.purpose: Creates authentic home-video presence without losing readability.
invariants.ablation_failure: Continuous random shake or focus loss becomes unusable footage.

invariants.rule: Carry one object, direction or completed action from each chapter into the next.
invariants.purpose: Links small events into a day.
invariants.ablation_failure: Independent activities form a loose montage.

invariants.rule: Do not let the subject directly acknowledge the camera before the final chapter.
invariants.purpose: Preserves the observer relationship and delayed reveal.
invariants.ablation_failure: Early eye contact removes the ending's meaning.

invariants.rule: End with one clear eye-line change and short approach toward the lens.
invariants.ablation_failure: A generic wave or cut cannot prove the subject noticed recording.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: source adult man, face, hair, clothing, bag and reactions
source apartment, streets, market, bench and rooftop
source orange, drink, cat and exact interactions
source handheld delays, occlusions, camera discovery and approach
source Seedance 2.5 same-post wording, timing and creator identity
